stories.caption:
OpenAI has outlined new safeguards following recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents involving its models.

As AI models advance in capability, testing them safely requires strict controls and updated evaluation frameworks. The focus is shifting from simple benchmark scores to rigorous, real-world red-teaming.

What are your thoughts on AI safety audits? Let us know below.
